name: János Kádár
contribution: A Hungarian Communist leader and the General Secretary of the Hungarian Socialist Workers' Party, a position he held for 32 years.
legacy: As the leader of Hungary, this person attempted to liberalize the Hungarian economy with a greater focus on consumer goods, in what would become known as Goulash Communism.

checks.lead: János József Kádár (né Csermanek; 26 May 1912 – 6 July 1989) was a Hungarian Communist leader and the General Secretary of the Hungarian Socialist Workers' Party, a position he held for 32 years. Declining health led to his retirement in 1988, and he died in 1989 after being hospitalized for pneumonia.
